page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor with an x86_64 architecture, delivering 8 dedicated vCPUs from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The CPU operates at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz and is equipped with a 40 MB L3 cache. System memory consists of 32.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core.

This instance integrates a single NVIDIA Pascal P4 GPU with 8 GB of dedicated VRAM, making it suitable for entry-level graphics rendering and inference workloads. However, the instance does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate that the legacy Intel Xeon architecture and Pascal-generation GPU position this instance in the lower performance tiers. Single-core stress-ng performance is in the bottom 10%, while multi-core CPU performance, memory bandwidth, and cryptographic operations fall within the bottom 25%. Despite these lower raw performance metrics, the instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for legacy GPU workloads, providing dedicated hardware resources and GPU acceleration without the premium associated with newer-generation architectures.

The ecs.gn5i-c8g1.2xlarge is best suited for workloads such as lightweight deep learning inference, video transcoding, entry-level 3D rendering, and general-purpose applications requiring GPU acceleration. It is also applicable for development and testing environments that simulate GPU-dependent production systems.
